frequency_question: How often does a legislative joint resolution of disapproval successfully pass and block a submitted nuclear cooperation agreement within the statutory window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal 123 agreements submitted to Congress for review under the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 where a joint resolution of disapproval was introduced and acted upon. Excludes agreements that lapsed or were withdrawn before formal congressional voting windows closed without a blocking resolution passing.

cases.name: Agreement for Cooperation Concerning Civil Uses of Atomic Energy with the United Arab Emirates (2009)
Agreement for Cooperation Concerning Peaceful Uses of Nuclear Energy with Vietnam (2014)

provenance_note: claims 15 cases from only 2 named (7.5x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 15 named submissions across decades; believed complete for modern statutory framework
known_gaps: Older Cold War era submissions with different statutory mechanics are excluded for lack of comparability.
skeleton: Total formal 123 agreement submissions resulting in active congressional review periods since 1980
multiplier: 15 total submissions reviewed under standard statutory windows; 0 successful blocks
validity_reason: Statutory review procedures under the Atomic Energy Act remain stable across decades unless major legislative reform occurs.
